---
title: Website breadcrumbs
---

## Overview

Website pages that appear in a sidebar get a breadcrumb trail above
their title, showing the path of sidebar sections that leads to the
page:

```
Guide  ›  Advanced  ›  Deep Page
```

Each crumb is a link. Section crumbs link to the section's first
entry (or to the section's own `href:` when it has one), and the
current page appears as the final crumb, linked to itself.

Breadcrumbs are enabled by default whenever a page belongs to a
sidebar and sits at least one section deep. Top-level pages — whose
trail would contain only themselves — don't show one.

## Disabling breadcrumbs

Turn breadcrumbs off for the whole site in `_quarto.yml`:

```yaml
website:
  bread-crumbs: false
```

Or for a single page, in its front matter:

```yaml
---
title: My Page
bread-crumbs: false
---
```

## Notes

- Breadcrumbs are shown on wide viewports as part of the page's title
  block. (Quarto 1 also shows a compact breadcrumb bar on narrow
  viewports; that bar is not yet available.)
- The trail is derived from the sidebar structure, so a page that
  doesn't appear in any sidebar has no breadcrumbs.
